blurb: The Katama Kitchen offers traditional diner fare with a fresh and local twist. Breakfast and lunch are served from May through October, with dinners added in July and August. Located in Edgartown, Massachusetts, 2 miles from downtown and just 1 mile from South Beach, the Katama Kitchen offers sweeping views of the Katama
